items.q: Can I see it before I commit?
items.a: Yes. Book a free tour on WhatsApp during staffed hours, or come in on a day pass. If you decide to join, your day pass counts in full toward your first month.
The space is staffed Sunday to Thursday, 9am to 9pm. Members with a membership or a private office enter any time, 24/7, using their fingerprint.
Life Tower, Zaid Ibn Alkhattab St, Al-Olaya, Al-Khobar. The tower is easy to spot from the main road, and reception will point you to the right floor on your first visit.

items.q: Can I take calls from my desk?
items.a: Short calls at your desk are fine. For longer calls or anything confidential, book the Al-Malqa meeting room by the hour, or ask the team at reception what's free.
Day passes and memberships cover one person. For meetings with guests, book the Al-Malqa room, or ask the team at reception during staffed hours.
Life Tower is easy to reach by car, and parking is available around the tower. Ask the team for the closest option when you visit.

items.q: What's the difference between a day pass and a membership?
items.a: A day pass is a single day in the shared space, with no commitment. A membership runs monthly and adds 24/7 fingerprint access and 15% off the Al-Malqa meeting room. Both are booked on mazj.sa.

items.q: What's included with a desk or office?
items.a: Fast Wi-Fi, free drinks, and the shared areas come with every plan. Members get 15% off the Al-Malqa meeting room, and monthly private offices get 20% off.

items.q: How do I book the meeting room?
items.a: Al-Malqa is booked by the hour on mazj.sa and seats up to 6, with a screen and a writable wall. Members and monthly private offices get a discount on the rate.
Bookings are confirmed and paid on mazj.sa and are non-refundable under the current policy. If your plans change, contact the team before your booking date and we'll do our best to help.
MAZJ opened recently, and the founding members are shaping what it becomes. Join early as one of the first 15 to help set the tone of the community and keep your founding perks.

items.q: Can I host an event at MAZJ?
items.a: Yes. Al-Ma'arij is our events hall, booked in 2 to 5 hour slots on mazj.sa. It suits workshops, meetups, launches, and training days.

items.q: How many people fit in the hall?
items.a: Al-Ma'arij seats up to 30, with a screen and a sound system already in place. Tell the team what you're running and they'll help you set the room up.
Checkout happens on mazj.sa. You can pay by card, and split payments with Tamara or Tabby where available.

items.q: Can I get a VAT invoice?
items.a: Yes. MAZJ is VAT-registered with tax number 310240548700003, and a tax invoice is issued for your booking on request.

AboutPage.title:
The blend is
the point
AboutPage.intro: MAZJ (مزج) means "to blend". It is a shared workspace in Al-Khobar, built as an interactive, learning environment for the Eastern Province's urban community.
AboutPage.principlesLabel: What every space here starts from
AboutPage.principlesTitle:
How a space earns
a whole day
AboutPage.principlesNote: MAZJ's own framework for building a room worth spending a day in.

principles.label: Purpose
principles.body: A firm reason to exist. Every room here starts from what it is for, long before it starts from what it looks like.

principles.label: Function
principles.body: Sized to real use, not to a floor plan. Six around a table in Al-Malqa, thirty in Al-Ma'arij, and a door that actually closes when the work needs quiet.

principles.label: Form
principles.body: Made to hold your attention for a whole day. Natural light, plants, and materials chosen so a long day feels shorter than it is.

AboutPage.storyBody: Home is full of distractions and cafés are never really yours. The Eastern Province's founders, freelancers, and teams needed a place of their own: somewhere to do focused work, and to run into the people doing the same. The name says the intent. Different people, different work, different stages, blended into one room.
AboutPage.spaceBody: Life Tower on Zaid Ibn Alkhattab Street, Al-Olaya, Al-Khobar. One address holding the shared floor, the private offices, the Al-Malqa meeting room, and Al-Ma'arij, the hall we run events in. Staffed Sunday to Thursday, 9am to 9pm.
AboutPage.communityBody: A workspace gives you a desk. A community gives you momentum. Since 2022 MAZJ has hosted more than forty workshops, talks, screenings and gatherings, from a sketching series that ran nine times to design sprints and film nights. Everyone is welcome here.
AboutPage.closingBody: The fastest way to understand MAZJ is to spend a day inside it. Book a tour, or look through what the community has already built here.
